description: This file defines the enum `SavingsInterestCalculationType`, which specifies the methods for calculating interest on savings accounts, including daily balance and average daily balance methods, along with associated utility methods.

classes.name: SavingsInterestCalculationType
classes.description: An enum representing different interest calculation methods for savings accounts, such as invalid, daily balance, and average daily balance.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the interest calculation type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the interest calculation type.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid interest calculation types, excluding INVALID.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer to the corresponding `SavingsInterestCalculationType`, defaulting to INVALID if input is null or unrecognized.
